info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Authorization Details API
info.description: The Authorization Details API provides access to specific authorization records by their unique IDs. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about each authorization, including status, issuer information, and associated transactions. It is particularly useful for financial institutions and integrations requiring a review of authorization histories for compliance and auditing purposes. Developers can utilize this API to facilitate user access to authorization data within their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific authorization by its unique identifier.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific authorization using its unique identifier (RES-100045). It returns the relevant data for the specified authorization, enabling users to verify and review authorization details easily.
